purpose: show ACR is not an artefact of an arbitrary baseline parameter
folds: shared canonical folds from acr_folds.py (identical to headline ACR)

temporal_persistence._note: Climatology-as-series-mean gives R2=0 by construction (it IS the R2 denominator), so it is a degenerate, uninformative temporal baseline and is not reported. Persistence (next=current) is PARAMETER-FREE — there is no temporal hyperparameter to sweep — so temporal ACR cannot be an artefact of a baseline-parameter choice. Temporal rows here are recomputed from the lag-aligned GEMS/NCP/GROW persistence experiments; the baseline-parameter robustness demonstration therefore lives on the spatial side (IDW k-sweep above).
